name: Hatsukoi Bloom
storyline: Hatsukoi Bloom puts the player in the shoes of a student who has just transferred into the second year of high school at a school in Japan. There, they meet many unique people, but three stand out: Aika Tanabe, Shiori Amasaki, and Mika Fujimoto. With these three, much more than just friendship can blossom.
summary:
Hatsukoi Bloom (初恋ブルーム) is a romance simulation game inspired by the emotional struggles often seen in shoujo and slice-of-life anime and manga. Players take on the role of a student navigating the highs and lows of first love, deep friendships, love triangles, and meaningful choices that shape the outcome of their relationships.

Beyond the classic decision-making elements of visual novels, Hatsukoi Bloom features interactive minigames and unique gameplay mechanics that can strengthen—or completely ruin—entire routes. With multiple endings, memorable characters, and an anime-inspired art style, this is a heartfelt journey designed for fans of romantic Japanese storytelling.
